equality_scope: Nonzero extremizers are scalar multiples of the zero-mean point-evaluation Green function at midpoints of longest paths.
integrity_note: Analytical Hilbert-space proof is distinguished from finite exact-rational checks. The standard Dirichlet Green kernel is background, not claimed original. Inaccessible unindexed specialist literature could cover the claim.
scientific_limitations: Only finite two-terminal parallel-path metric graphs, positive edge lengths, uniform arclength and quadratic derivative energy; no vertex atoms, edge density weights, attached branches or higher-order Sobolev energies. External independent mathematical audit remains outstanding.
title: Longest-path localization for sharp Sobolev evaluation on parallel-path metric graphs
